records.en_original: (So, you are indeed able to repel me.)
records.en_auxiliary: (So, you are indeed able to repel me.)

records.jp: （小さき欠片よ、我が身を映すものよ。<CR>お前のことは忘れない）
records.en_original: (My dear fragment, child who reflects my being, I shall not soon forget the likes of you you.)
records.en_auxiliary: (My dear fragment—child who reflects my being—I shall not soon forget the likes of you you.)
records.en: (Little fragment, reflection of my being.<CR>I will not forget you.)

records.jp: あー、このままひっくり返りたい
records.en_original: Ahhhh... I'm just going to collapse right here, thanks.
records.en_auxiliary: Ahhhh... I just want to collapse right here.
records.en: Ahh... I just want to fall over right here.

records.en_original: ...Aren't you worried your clothes will get dirty?
records.en_auxiliary: Your clothes are gonna get dirty.
records.en: ...Your uniform will get dirty, you know?

records.jp: ほら、ヒナちゃんもこっち来て！
records.en_original: You get down here too, Hina.
records.en_auxiliary: You get over here too, Hina.

records.jp: 子供の頃から、よく二人でこうして『背もたれ座り』してたんだ
records.en_original: When we were little, we would always sit back to back.
records.en_auxiliary: When we were little, we would always sit back-to-back.
records.en: Ever since we were little, the two of us often sat like this, back-to-back.

records.jp: どこでも座れて楽なの。でも、どっちかが立つと、<CR>残ったほうはひっくり返っちゃうんだけど……
records.en_original: It's really comfortable and lets you sit anywhere, but if someone stands up, the other will fall over...
records.en_auxiliary: It's really comfortable and lets you sit anywhere, but if someone stands up, the other will fall over...
records.en: It's comfortable, and you can sit anywhere. But if one of us stands up,<CR>the other falls over...

records.en_auxiliary: And now there's three of us.
records.en: Now there are three of us.
Now there are three of us.

records.jp: でもね、大丈夫――。ヒナちゃんは、大丈夫
records.en_original: But it's okay. You're gonna be okay.
records.en_auxiliary: But it's okay. You're gonna be okay.
records.en: But it'll be okay—Hina-chan, you'll be okay.

records.jp: 記憶が消えちゃうから、寂しくないよ
records.en_original: You'll forget everything, so you shouldn't feel lonely.
records.en_auxiliary: You'll forget everything, so you shouldn't feel lonely.
records.en: You'll forget everything, so you shouldn't feel lonely.

records.en_original: I'll never forget about you two!
records.en_auxiliary: I'll never forget about you two!
records.en: I'll never forget about you two!

records.jp: 私……、なんでこんな所にいるんだろう……？
records.en: Why am I in a place like this...?

records.jp: これでもう大丈夫だね
records.en_original: I think things are alright now.
records.en_auxiliary: I think things are all right now.
records.en: Everything will be all right now.

records.jp: うん。世界は守られた。<CR>ライムたちの役目はこれで終わり
records.en_original: Yeah. The world is saved. We completed our mission.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. The world is saved. We completed our mission.
records.en: Yeah. The world is safe.<CR>Lime and the others have fulfilled their role.

records.jp: 終わりの、本当の終わり。<CR>そして、始まりの始まり
records.en_original: This is the end of the end, but it's also the beginning of the beginning.
records.en_auxiliary: This is the end of the end, but it's also the beginning of the beginning.
records.en: The true end of the end.<CR>And the beginning of the beginning.

records.en_original: We gave it our all, right?
records.en_auxiliary: We gave it our all, right?
records.en: We gave it our all, right?

records.jp: うん。でも大丈夫。ライムたちはこれからも一緒
records.en_original: Yeah, but we'll be fine. We'll be together, like always.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, but we'll be fine. We'll be together, like always.
records.en: Yeah. But it'll be okay. Lime and the others will always be together.

records.jp: ずっと、繋がってるから。あの世界で
records.en_original: We're with them. In that world.
records.en_auxiliary: We'll always be connected. In that world.
records.en: Because we'll always be connected. In that world.

records.jp: ヒナちゃん、忘れないよ
ヒナちゃん、忘れないよ
